name: Library doctor
author: Lichtspiel
description: Looks through the library after each scan and once a day, and shows admins on its own page in the left menu what may need a hand: titles that are there twice, low resolutions, no audio in the chosen languages, files that could not be read, movies without a year, episodes without numbers, titles without details. Settings: the languages the audio should be in (e.g. ["de"]), the smallest width that is fine (1280 = HD; 0 = do not check), libraries to leave out by name (e.g. an anime library).
